senses.gloss: रेभ् रेभ &c. See √ रिभ्, p. 880, col. 3.
रेभ॑ mfn. creaking, crackling, murmuring, resounding, RV.
रेभ॑ m. a praiser, panegyrist, celebrator, ib.; AV.
N. of a Ṛṣi (who was cast into a well by the Asuras and lay there for ten nights and nine days until rescued by the Aśvins; he is the supposed author of RV. viii, 97, having the patr. काश्यप), RV.
रेभा (आ), f. = शोभा, Āpast., Sch. (cf. रेभाय).
रेभ—सूनु m. du. two sons of Rebha, authors of RV. ix, 99; 100.
रेभण n. the lowing of kine, L.
रेभाय Nom. P. ˚यति, to shine, beam, Āpast.
रेभिन् mfn. (ifc.) causing to resound, Śiś.
रेभिल or रेभि˚लक, m. N. of a man, Mṛcch.
रेभिल or रेभि˚लक, m. N. of a man, Mṛcch.
